description:
# Introduction

This repository contains all the custom scripts used in the evaluation and comparison of [Katdetectr](https://github.com/ErasmusMC-CCBC/evaluation_katdetectr/tree/main) as described in the corresponding Technical Note (under submission).

# Usage

All required files were deposited on [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/record/6623289#.YqBxHi8Rr0o%5D).
These can directly be downloaded using `zen4R` and be used as input.

```R
# Increase the timeout (due to some large files).
options(timeout=5000)

# Download the required files into the data/ folder (~1GB).
zen4R::download_zenodo(doi = "10.5281/zenodo.6810477", path = 'data/')
```
name: Performance evaluation of Katdetectr and other kataegis detection packages
